identity.name: Indian Overseas Bank
identity.industry: Banking — Public Sector Bank (GoI 92.44%; high-ROE turnaround PSB)

summary.oneLiner: a set most private banks would envy. Asset quality kept improving into seasonally weak Q1, accumulated losses are now fully wiped out

one-line thesis: Best-in-class PSB "consistency" quarter: all-time-high PAT INR 1,659 cr (+49.3% YoY) on NII +34.3%, NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% domestic, ROA 1.41% and ROE 22.7% — a set most private banks would envy. Asset quality kept improving into seasonally weak Q1 (GNPA 1.33%, NNPA 0.18%, slippage 0.06%), accumulated losses are now fully wiped out, and CAR 19.36% is a fortress. The watch-items are all "quality-of-beat" ones: a large PSLC-commission (INR 863 cr) + tech-write-off-recovery (~INR 490 cr) contribution that management insists is recurring, a 10% QoQ corporate-book contraction (one ~INR 10,000 cr account exited on pricing), and a coming INR 5,000 cr equity raise (GoI still 92.44%, so MPS/dilution optics).
financial scorecard (track qoq/yoy): > "Quality" flags: PSLC-sale commission INR 863 cr + recovery from technically-written-off a/cs ~INR 490 cr are large, but mgmt insists both have recurred in all of the last 8–9 quarters (routine non-interest income). SMA book INR 13,000 cr = 4.05% (down from 4.95%; SMA0 5,733 / SMA1 3,068 / SMA2 4,246 cr — SMA2 +INR 500 cr QoQ). Accumulated losses now nil (wiped via internal accrual + share-premium netting). BVPS disclosed 15.79 vs ~20.5 on net-worth/shares — a disclosure/adjustment gap an analyst flagged.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter: Credit / advances growth: 13–14% minimum FY27 (has run ~20–22% last 3 yrs; "minimum we want to grow").
Corporate loan book: +12–13% by FY27-end (INR 14,000 cr already sanctioned, in disbursement) — recovering the -10% QoQ dip.
NIM: maintained 3.3–3.4% (all TD repricing already done 6 months ago; CASA-led).
ROA: ~1.46% by FY27-end (internal floor 1.20%; 1.4–1.5% over next 2–3 quarters); NIM-driven, not opex.
Credit cost: 0.35–0.40% full-year FY27 (0.14% in Q1).
ECL: total requirement ~INR 3,000 cr; INR 2,150 cr already provided (1,700 till Mar + 400 this Q); rest to be fully provided within FY27 — not taking the 4-year RBI dispensation.
ECLGS: universe INR 4,400 cr; INR 2,600 cr disbursed; balance INR 1,800 cr → 95–100% by Aug-end / early-Sep.
Capital: INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved; to hit market Q3/Q4 FY27 in 1–2+ tranches.
GIFT City: build book to ~USD 500 mn by FY27-end (internal budget).
FCNR(B): mobilised USD 300 mn; intend to double to USD 600–650 mn by Sep-2026 (dispensation window end).
order book & pipeline: Not an order-book model. Growth pipeline = corporate sanctions INR 14,000 cr in disbursement stages; RAM (~80% of book) uniformly growing; FCNR(B)/NRI mobilisation via 4 overseas centres + 4.5 lakh existing NRI customers; new GIFT City IFSC branch (USD 500 mn target book).
segment / subsidiary detail: RAM (~80% of book): primary yield + growth engine; big-ticket MSME/agri loans (INR 3–5 cr) classified RAM per RBI definition. Gold-backed = ~40% of agriculture general loans; no agri delinquencies seen/expected.
Corporate (~20%): -10% QoQ purely from exiting one ~INR 10,000 cr low-priced account in Apr (~40% of impact absorbed in Q1); disciplined "no loss-making business at sub-7%".
International: 4 countries; new GIFT City IFSC branch upcoming.
Digital: ~96% of transactions digital; ~75% of customer onboarding digital; 10-min laptop/mobile loan sanction, 2-min digital locker allotment (Big-Four-led revamp 3–4 yrs ago).
growth verticals / optionality: GIFT City IFSC branch — new international-monetisation lever (USD 500 mn book target FY27).
FCNR(B) / NRI leverage — USD 300→600–650 mn doubling by Sep; taps 4.5 lakh NRI base.
DTA / capital efficiency — INR 200 cr DTA added to net worth this Q.
margins & cost dynamics: NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% domestic; +12 bps QoQ. Levers: yield on advances +10 bps QoQ (better pricing; 54% MCLR / 37% RLLR-linked) + cost of deposits -10 bps QoQ (aggressive CASA @ ~41%, bulk deposits kept to just 6–7% of total, all TD repricing already complete). Future ROA uplift framed as NIM-driven (both higher interest income and lower interest expense).
Fee income +20% YoY to INR 476 cr (from 398 cr) — low-base optics; core exchange/commission/LC/BG/locker/processing.
capex / expansion (watch slippage): Not a capex story. "Expansion" = 3,522 branches / 3,691 ATMs / 13,401 BCs footprint + GIFT City branch build-out (~2 months to physical existence) + digital stack. No hard capex figures.
capital allocation: INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved, to be raised Q3/Q4 FY27 (GoI 92.44%; also helps SEBI MPS). CAR already 19.36% vs 11.50% min — raise is offensive/growth + float, not distress. Accumulated losses fully cleared this quarter (enables future dividend capacity). ECL being front-loaded (no 4-yr dispensation) — conservative capital use.
risks & watch-items: "Quality of beat": PSLC INR 863 cr + tech-w/o recovery ~INR 490 cr are large; mgmt calls them recurring, but they inflate the headline vs pure operating earnings.
Corporate-book contraction: -10% QoQ; recovery to +12–13% is a FY27-end promise to verify.
SMA2 tick-up: +INR 500 cr QoQ (though total SMA down INR 2,200 cr) — monitor slippage.
Dilution / MPS optics: INR 5,000 cr raise with GoI at 92.44%.
West Asia conflict: "looming large again"; no product/sector stress seen yet in SME/small-borrower book.
ECLGS tail: INR 1,800 cr still to disburse; CGTMSE/CGFMU cover ~15–16% of credit.
management quality / tone: Highly confident, "consistency is our hallmark" tone from CEO Srivastava (11-quarter one-directional track record). Candid on the corporate-book exit rationale ("we do not want to do any loss-making business… not for sub-7% corporate"), transparent on ECL front-loading and the SMA2 uptick, and precise on data points (DTA/MTM bridge, SMA buckets, ECLGS split). Guides conservatively (13–14% "minimum") while over-delivering — a credibility-builder. No over-promising on NIM (held-band framing).
non-obvious takeaways: A PSB printing ROE 22.7% / ROA 1.41% / NIM 3.48% domestic — better than most private peers — yet still trades/optically screens as a PSU; the re-rating question is whether the market fully credits the earnings quality.
The -10% QoQ corporate book is self-inflicted discipline, not demand loss — a positive read once the +12–13% FY27 recovery lands.
Accumulated losses now nil is a quiet but structural milestone (dividend capacity + cleaner capital math ahead of the raise).
ECL being fully provided within FY27 (no 4-yr dispensation) removes a future overhang other PSBs will still be carrying.
PSLC + tech-w/o recovery recurring "every quarter for 8–9 quarters" is the crux of the bull/bear debate on sustainable ROA.

> Other topics (ECL front-loading, PSLC income, West Asia watch, capital raise, GIFT City) are internal/regulatory — no external listed beneficiary/loser to map.
qoq change log (fill each quarter): Q1FY27 (this): PAT INR 1,659 cr (+49.3%, all-time high), OP INR 2,693 cr (+14.2%), NII +34.3%, NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% dom, ROA 1.41%, ROE 22.69%, CAR 19.36%. Advances INR 3,22,132 cr (+22.75%; corp -10% QoQ), Deposits INR 3,76,193 cr (+13.72%), CASA 41.45%. GNPA 1.33% / NNPA 0.18% / PCR 97.67% / slippage 0.06%; SMA 4.05%. PSLC INR 863 cr, tech-w/o recovery ~INR 490 cr. Accumulated losses wiped to nil. Guidance: advances 13–14% min, corp +12–13% FY27, NIM 3.3–3.4%, ROA ~1.46% FY27, credit cost 0.35–0.40%, ECL fully provided in FY27, INR 5,000 cr equity + 1,000 cr Tier-2 Q3/Q4, GIFT City USD 500 mn, FCNR(B) → USD 600–650 mn by Sep.

next → check: corporate book turning back to growth (+12–13% path); NIM held 3.3–3.4%; ROA toward 1.46%; PSLC/recovery recurrence (sustainability of beat); ECLGS 95–100% disbursed; capital raise execution + pricing; GIFT City book build; FCNR(B) doubling; SMA2 trajectory.
